name: Mount Everest
overview: The world's highest mountain. Requires prior high-altitude experience, supplemental oxygen planning and extensive permits.

name: K2
overview: One of the most technically demanding 8,000 m peaks, with a serious fatality record. Expert-level only.

name: Denali
overview: North America's highest peak: extreme cold, glacier travel and heavy loads. NPS registration and fees apply.

name: Aconcagua
overview: Highest peak outside Asia. Non-technical by the normal route but a serious high-altitude objective. Permit required.

name: Mount Kilimanjaro
overview: A walk-up high-altitude trek where altitude sickness remains the main risk. Park fees and licensed operators required.

name: Mont Blanc
overview: Western Europe's highest summit. Glacier travel, rockfall and fast-changing weather; acclimatization and guiding strongly advised.
